description: This file defines the AutoEscapeNode class within the Twig templating library, representing an autoescape node in the Twig syntax tree. It specifies how autoescaping behavior is handled in templates, including the escaping strategy (like html or js) and whether autoescaping is enabled or disabled.

classes.name: AutoEscapeNode
classes.description: Represents an autoescape node in the Twig syntax tree, managing the autoescaping strategy and its associated body content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AutoEscapeNode with the specified escaping strategy, body node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the autoescape node into PHP code using the provided compiler instance.
